# Azure Ore

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-azure-ore.md" title="Azure Ore"><img src="icons/120.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Azure Ore"></a>

Dark fractured stone threaded with bright blue crystal seams. A finite underground deposit found at **Y −96 to 8**, with the strongest generation preference near **Y −40**. These are world heights, not depth below the surface. Ore replaces stone and does not regenerate after mining. Smelt the mined ore into an [Azure Crystal](Item-azure-crystal.md).

![Azure ore seams in a natural underground deposit](images/azure-natural-deposit.png)

![The Azure ore model held in game](images/azure-held.png)

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Required mining tool | Copper pickaxe or better |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Find this deposit in stone. Mine it with a **copper pickaxe or better**.

Mining yields <a href="Item-azure-ore.md" title="Azure Ore"><img src="icons/120.png" width="40" height="40" alt="Azure Ore"><br>Azure Ore</a> ×1.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
